title: dryopteris hornei
intro: Dryopteris hornei, commonly known as Horne's male fern, is a species of fern in the family Dryopteridaceae. It is an edible and medicinal plant that has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including respiratory issues and digestive problems. The health benefits of Horne's male fern include its anti-inflammatory and antispasmodic properties, which can help to soothe and calm the body. The plant contains bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, including expectorant and diuretic properties.
